result.instruction: In `debouncer_top`, replace the transparent child instance with top-level sequential logic and retain the required `// @latency 0` annotation. Remove the `noisy_prev` register: clear the 3-bit stability counter when `noisy == clean_reg`, and while they differ, advance the counter until its existing terminal value, then update `clean_reg` and clear the counter. Preserve the synchronous active-high reset, output hold behavior, and update of `clean` on the eighth consecutive sample of a differing value; seek fewer FFs without increasing LUTs.
